sources.entry: OpenClip - Lightweight floating action bar for macOS that turns selected text into instant actions.

summary.one_liner: OpenClip is an open-source macOS menubar app that shows a floating action bar when you select text, offering actions like case transforms, search, math, shell scripts, shortcuts and optional AI queries.
summary.what_it_does: The app detects selected text in any application using Accessibility permission and shows a contextual bar near the selection. The bar offers built-in actions such as case transform, search, copy/cut, and math evaluation, plus custom actions. A search palette, opened with the ⌥⌘C hotkey, does fuzzy search across the full action catalog. Users can add extensions as folders in ~/.openclip/extensions/, written in JavaScript, Shell, AppleScript, or as URL schemes, and can install community extensions from a Preferences Extension Store. Optional AI actions can use local Ollama models, Apple Intelligence, or OpenAI/Anthropic API keys. The README states zero telemetry and that execution is local.
use_cases: Transform selected text in any macOS app
Run shell scripts on selected text
Evaluate math expressions from a selection
Search the web for highlighted words
Send selected text to a local or cloud AI model
how_to_run: git clone the repository and cd into openclip
notable: Floating action bar appears near the text selection in any app
Extensions are plain folders with an openclip.json manifest
Optional AI actions via local Ollama, Apple Intelligence, or OpenAI/Anthropic keys
Search palette on ⌥⌘C for fuzzy searching all actions
Privacy-first: README claims zero telemetry and fully local execution
caveats: Requires macOS 14+ and Accessibility permission to detect selected text
Building from source needs Xcode 16+ and XcodeGen
AI actions need Ollama, Apple Intelligence, or your own OpenAI/Anthropic keys
keywords: open-source alternative to selection popup tools
